data.description: 雨点敲着玻璃，她坐在窗边捧着茶杯，难得没有查看放在一旁的日程。

data.promptProse: Leaning comfortably against a wooden kitchen counter in the morning, Bazett holds a warm ceramic mug in both hands. Gentle sunlight filters through lace window curtains, softly illuminating the stove and kitchen shelves.
data.animaCaption: Relaxed beside the wooden kitchen counter, she wraps both hands around a warm ceramic mug with a quiet, unhurried expression. Soft morning light filters through lace curtains onto the stovetop kettle and shelves.
